feature_notes.bucket: floor(log2(mean 14-bar TR / close of the 5m bar before the touch)*4)
feature_notes.log_vol_ratio: log of quote volume of the hour ending at the close of the 5m bar before the touch / median hourly quote volume of the prior 7 days
feature_notes.log_approach: log1p(minutes from the first post-Monday cross of the near Monday edge to the touch bar)
feature_notes.opp_first: 1 if the opposite 1.618 of the same symbol-week filled earlier
feature_notes.monday_close_side: Monday close position, 0 = edge away from this touch, 1 = edge this touch extends
feature_notes.log_liquidity: log10 mean daily quote volume of the 7 days ending at the close of the 5m bar before the touch (USDT)
feature_notes.toward24: percent move toward the level over the 24h ending at the close of the 5m bar before the touch
feature_notes.cluster24: other symbols filling the same side in the prior 24h
